en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub,
(The narrator) who asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who baited a fish, so he tied it with a thread, and sent it in the water, so it died. Can he eat it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ayyub who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about the case of a man who catches fish, then ties it to a string, then sends it in the water where it dies; if he can use it for food. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, he must not use it for food.’”
